title: AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2
abstract: arXiv:2611.31076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a single-player deck-building game that requires long-term planning under heavy randomness. We present AlphaDefect, an expert-level AI system for STS2: for each character, one network trained with proximal policy optimization (PPO) makes every decision of a run, in combat and outside it. At the highest difficulty, Ascension 10, on two versions of the game current in November 2026 and on test seeds not played in training, AlphaDefect wins 62-77% of runs across six characters with greedy play and 68-80% with test-time search, after 1.3 to 6.7 billion decisions of training per character; runs uploaded by human players of all levels are won 11-20% of the time at the same difficulty. The networks read the game as entity records that identify each card, relic and enemy through a learned embedding and attributes from the game data, together with consequences of public information computed by the engine. translated_abstract: 《杀戮尖塔2》(STS2) 是一款单人卡组构建游戏，需要在高度随机性下进行长期规划。我们提出了AlphaDefect，一个面向STS2的专家级AI系统：对于每个角色，仅用一个通过近端策略优化(PPO)训练的网络来完成单次对局中的所有决策，涵盖战斗内与战斗外的各个环节。在最高难度“飞升10”下，基于2026年11月时的两个游戏版本以及训练中从未玩过的测试种子，AlphaDefect在六个角色上使用贪婪策略时赢得62-77%的对局，使用测试时搜索时赢得68-80%的对局（每个角色经过13亿至67亿次决策的训练）；而在相同难度下，各水平人类玩家上传的对局胜率仅为11-20%。这些网络将游戏状态读取为实体记录，通过学习到的嵌入以及来自游戏数据的属性来识别每张卡牌、遗物和敌人，并结合由游戏引擎计算出的公共信息后果。消融实验显示……
tldr: AlphaDefect通过PPO训练单一神经网络控制全部对局决策，在《杀戮尖塔2》最高难度下取得62-80%的胜率，远超人类玩家11-20%的水平。
en_tdlr: AlphaDefect, trained with PPO to make all in-run decisions with a single network per character, achieves 62-80% win rates at Slay the Spire 2's highest difficulty, far surpassing human players' 11-20%.
